exemptions.name: USER_SETTINGS_CHAT_STYLE

exemptions.name: USER_SETTINGS
exemptions.reason: Current parser validates a 26-byte prefix and a staged native optional tail including a length-prefixed style string; the former flat Java schema has a different tail. Existing UserSettings parser suites exercise these branches.

exemptions.name: ROOM_MODEL
exemptions.reason: Current floor-map parser reads an optional counted area-hide list and camera x/y/z after the boolean,int,string prefix; the legacy Java schema describes only that prefix. Existing floor-map parser suites exercise this optional extension.

exemptions.name: CAMERA_STORAGE_URL
exemptions.reason: Current parser reads the URL plus an optional length-prefixed PNG guarded by JSON length and PNG-header validation; the Java URL-only schema does not describe this conditional optimization. Existing camera parser suites exercise these branches.

exemptions.name: ROOM_RIGHTS

exemptions.name: ROOM_RIGHTS_CLEAR
